name: ai-native-game-harness-workspace
description: AI Native Game Harness distribution and plugin workspace.

scripts.check: pnpm run build && pnpm run test
scripts.desktop:dsh: pnpm integration:xiaotangyuan && pnpm --filter @ai-native-game-harness/game-transport... build && pnpm --filter @ai-native-game-harness/game-learning-binding build && pnpm --filter @ai-native-game-harness/dsh-story-generator... build && pnpm --filter @ai-native-game-harness/desktop start:dsh
scripts.check:xiaotangyuan: pnpm run check:dst && pnpm --filter @qimidandapigu/xiaotangyuan-feedback-receiver check && pnpm --filter @qimidandapigu/oni-adapter check && pnpm --filter @qimidandapigu/dsh-xiaotangyuan-game check
scripts.desktop:prepare: pnpm integration:xiaotangyuan && pnpm --filter @ai-native-game-harness/game-transport... build && pnpm --filter @ai-native-game-harness/game-learning-binding build && pnpm --filter @ai-native-game-harness/dsh-story-generator... build && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/prepare-desktop-runtime.ps1
scripts.desktop:start: pnpm integration:xiaotangyuan && pnpm --filter @ai-native-game-harness/game-transport... build && pnpm --filter @ai-native-game-harness/game-learning-binding build && pnpm --filter @ai-native-game-harness/dsh-story-generator... build && pnpm --filter @ai-native-game-harness/desktop start
